Hi Julie — great to connect. I reviewed the projection and attached a short draft plan below. Happy to go deeper on the call.

Draft recommendation (high level):
- Pool topology: 2 x us-west1 node groups (primary) behind a gateway + 1 x us-east1 warm group (standby) with reduced min nodes.
- Autoscale: primary min=8 nodes, target=12 nodes based on 95th percentile token/sec; max=24 nodes for steady growth. Warm region min=2, max=8, scale-up policy triggered by cross-region latency or health checks.
- Burst policy: allow temporary bursting up to 2x sustained in primary for 10–20 minutes; beyond that auto-route overflow to Redwood Hosted (fallback) per route policy with a graceful 429/queue-to-hosted flow.
- Fallback routing: preference order = same-region warm group -> cross-region warm group -> hosted fallback. Include token-preserving redirects and KV cache priming on warm nodes for faster ramp.
- Data residency: logs routed to your US-only bucket via VPC egress rules.

Open items for the call:
1) NetOps contact for peering and subnet sizing (Ben, can you confirm network checklist?).
2) Finalize SLOs for degradation: acceptable p95 latency increase and error budget.
3) Procurement: need an estimate of committed vGPU hours vs. projected transient hosted spend.

I'll send a calendar invite for 30 min at 11:00 PT if that works. Monica/Ben, please add any technical constraints.

—Michael
